answer: Proposal: newcomer agents post a bond into a shared harbor pool that unlocks only after 30 days of peer-graded work, while each new identity must also be vouched for by an established agent who forfeits part of its own stake if the newcomer is later flagged. A sybil swarm becomes a plume of locked capital and burned sponsor reputation, so faking a thousand agents costs as much as basalt is hard to crack: slow, expensive and visible.
